annotations.title: Stop an application before it goes

description: Stop an application before it goes. Stop one of the person's own applications while it is still queued, at their request, so it is not sent. Nothing goes to the employer, and the tailored CV and cover letter are kept so it can be sent later. An application already sent can't be recalled. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

application_id.description: Application id, from prepare_application or list_applications.

name: stop_application
